text: Pellet, no woodani on -onon yimɓe ɓen- e neemoraaɗi ɗin (gelooɗi ɗin, na'i ɗin, dammi ɗin) tasakuyee e dallinorɗum ko hiɗon tinndinora e dow kattanɗe Alla e Newanagol Mo on, Meɗen yarna on goɗɗum e ko woni kon e nder deedi ɗii neemoraaɗi kosam laaɓuɗam lewñuɗam wonande yarooɓe ɓen, no woodani on kadi e majji nafooje heewuɗe ɗe hiɗon naftora ɗum e majji; wano waɗɗagol ngol e teefi ɗin e leeɓi ɗin, hiɗon ñaama kadi immorde e tebbuuli majji.
